summary: Add inactive per-job Linux scope plans, apply and per-field readback (unit 12a)

rules.detail: No host activation; gate-slot remains the admission path. apply() returning Ok means only that all writes completed, not that the scope is safe to launch. Unit 7 must refuse a launch unless all four readback matches are Measured and true; missing or malformed fields are Unknown.

compatibility.detail: Additive inactive Rust scope plan and systemd properties with Delegate=yes, configured heavy ceilings, host-page-aligned memory high/max, zero swap and configured task count. page_size() reads the host page size. io.weight is not an IO limit and has no effect with NVMe scheduler none. Writes are not atomic; an error can leave a partially configured scope.
